$comment: GENERATED FILE — DO NOT EDIT. Produced by scripts/buildCliHelp.ts from the JSDoc above each route() in src/cli/engine/routes. Edit the comment on the route, then run `npm run prepare` (or `npm run docs:api`).

notes: Send it with `curl --get --data-urlencode` rather than putting it in a shell-visible URL.

currency-configs.summary: List plugin ids usable for wallet creation.
currency-configs.description: Currency and accountbased plugins only — swap plugins are excluded.

engine-config.description: What the engine passed to `makeEdgeContext`. Contains no secrets. Use it to assert tester hosts before a test run.
notes: Outside `-t` / `--test`, `servers` is an empty object — core is using its built-in production defaults, so there is nothing to echo back.

engine-status.description: The readiness probe the client polls after auto-spawning the engine.

engine-stop.description: Logs out every session, closes the context, unlinks the socket and run-file, then exits. The engine answers before it starts tearing down, so a response is not proof the process is gone.
notes: In-flight callers may see `503 ENGINE_SHUTTING_DOWN` once teardown starts.

fetch-challenge.description: Lets a client solve a challenge before it hits `403 CHALLENGE_REQUIRED` mid-flow.

fetch-login-messages.summary: Fetch login-server messages for every local user.

params.recoveryKey: From `change-recovery`, stored by the user out of band.

forget-account.summary: Forget an account on this device.
forget-account.description: Removes locally cached credentials. The remote account is untouched.

params.rootLoginId: Core takes a `rootLoginId`. A username is also accepted and resolved against `localUsers` first, so callers need not hash it.

local-users.summary: List local users on this device.

request-otp-reset.description: Starts the timed reset a user falls back on after losing their authenticator.

username-available.summary: Check whether a username is free.

params.challengeId: Supply after solving a CAPTCHA to retry the same check.
